_comment: Optional. Copy to <INTERP_DIR>/data_config.json. Every key is optional; the copilot auto-detects what it can.
seismic_crs: EPSG:XXXX  (optional: if given, lon/lat shapefiles are converted with pyproj instead of auto-calibration on the Fault CSV)
polygon_name_number: unknown   (one of: twt_ms, sample_index, twt_ms_plus_offset, unknown) - meaning of the number in folder names such as 0080_Channel_01
